original.target_description: Study 2: weapon-identification task; between-participant contrast of power spectral density (PSD) slopes for control versus the average of use-race and avoid-race instruction conditions, using two orthogonal condition codes. Primary unadjusted effort contrast, not the pairwise comparisons or the average-latency-adjusted analysis.

n.sample_role: Undergraduate participants in the three-condition PSD-slope analysis; Table 2 gives control n=24, use-race n=25, avoid-race n=22.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported for Study 2; the group sample sizes in Table 2 account for the full stated sample. PSD estimation excludes log frequencies greater than zero and removes effects of trial type, accuracy, and trial number; these are processing steps rather than participant exclusions.

notes:
Replication article title and DOI verified from full-text header. Table 1 is the primary authors’ printed table for these replication contrasts. Table 1 also reproduces original-study values, but these were not substituted for independently examined original-paper statistics. Original DOI landing fetch denied by robots; OpenAlex reports no open-access location; targeted open-access PDF search and author-lab publications alternative did not provide original full text within acquisition budget. No metric conversions performed.
Source follow-up: Fresh original-only extraction from the supplied published-article text; title, author, journal and DOI match the assigned reference. Locator p. 9 corresponds to PDF p. 9 / printed p. 56. The neutral locator identifies Study 2 effort and 1/f noise; the primary planned contrast compares control with the two effort conditions averaged. The same original Study 2 target is assigned to both audit IDs. No replication or reported-success extraction was performed.
